newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi stock index up slightly, value soars.
newsitem.headline: Saudi stock index up slightly, value soars.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's stock market index rose slightly in the week to Thursday while trading value soared due to expectations of stronger prices, Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) said on Saturday.
The all-share index closed up 0.44 percent at 163.17 points. During the week 30 concerns rose, 15 fell and 25 were unchanged.
Trading value jumped 101 percent to 688 million riyals ($183.5 million) "due to investors fresh sentiment on the future expected rise of stock prices," a BFA report said.

The banking sector dominated trading value with 42 percent of the total. Several banks in the kingdom last week announced first half results. Cement sector shares came in second place accounting for 35 percent of the total traded value.
Total trading volume doubled during the week with almost three million shares changing hands in 6,388 deals.
Property acquisition and management company SRECO led last week's gainers, closing up 5.3 percent at 140 riyals. Qassim Cement rose 3.5 percent to close at 321 riyals.
Supermarket chain al-Azizia Panda fell 4.8 percent to close at 118 riyals followed by GACO's 4.3 percent drop to 22 riyals.
